messages:
maria: Hey @josh @kai — I pushed the fixes you asked for in #3242 (split out the kv allocator change, added unit test, adjusted logging). PTAL when you have a moment. CI green locally but waiting on infra. diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3242 :eyes:

josh: Thanks — quick skim looks good. Can you call out the one behaviour change for eviction in the PR description? small follow-up.

maria: added a short note under 'Behavioral changes' and included the log sample. Also added a fallback metric tag per @kai's suggestion.

kai: Nice. One small nit: rename metric 'kv_alloc_rotate' -> 'kv_allocator_rotate' for consistency. Otherwise LGTM. :+1:

maria: done — pushed. Also fixed the flake in test_kv_rotate by adding a timing backoff. CI is rerunning.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for PR #3242 (sha: ab12cd3). Status: running

josh: once CI passes can we canary this on staging for a day? I'll take ownership of the canary run.

maria: thanks — I'll queue the canary job after CI. Should I merge on green or wait for the staging smoke to finish?

kai: merge on green, then trigger canary job. If smoke fails we'll revert quickly.

josh: sounds good. tagging @oncall in case of regressions.

maria: CI passed. merging now. :shipit:

deploy-bot: PR #3242 merged by maria (sha: ab12cd3). Deployed to staging canary.

josh: taking the canary watch. ping here if you see anything odd. :eyes:

maria: will do, thanks all.
